description: Mounted on a pylon at the 'Welcome to Yellowknife' sign at the airport entrance, in the blue and red of Wardair, and the best-known bush-flying monument in the Northwest Territories. Ex G-AMRV. On 6 May 1967, flown by Captain Don Braun, it became the first wheel-equipped aircraft to land at the North Pole; retired early in 1968. A short stair path leads up to it and there is a picnic area and a 2.5 km trail alongside. Vandalised with graffiti in recent years.
aliases: B-170; B170; Bristol Freighter; Wayfarer; CF-TFX; G-AMRV
